Name: Nyapu Style Portraits for Pelican Palette
Author: Howaa
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
[size=3]I really dig little slice of life activities in games, I often reminisce on the comedy club and basketball mini-games in the Urbz for DS and I've wished for similar mechanics in my SDV playthroughs. So I was excited for a mod like Pelican Palette that introduces painting into Stardew~ This mod retextures the three NPCs packaged in the mod to be Nyapu-styled.[/size]

[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
This is a file replacement mod! So you'll need to drag my [CP] Pelican Palette folder into the "Pelican Palette" folder in your mods folder to allow my portraits to overwrite the originals, then you're done! 

[b][size=4]Shout outs[/size][/b]
